options.content:
### Artaban · AURA — HRI condition monitoring
`ROS 2 / Vulcanexus` → `Orion-LD (NGSI-LD, DDS bridge)` → `TROE · TimescaleDB` → `Mintaka` → **Grafana**  ·  Powered by FIWARE · ARISE all-in-one middleware  ·  [Open AURA dashboard (WireCloud) ↗](http://localhost:8000/admin/aura)

panels.title: Session KPIs (latest HRISession computed by aura-monitor)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT number AS "Command success"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/commandSuccessRate'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT number AS "False activations"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/falseActivationRate'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT number AS "Rejection (5 min)"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/windowRejectionRate'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT number AS "Confirm loops / 10"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/confirmationLoopRate'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT number AS "p95 latency"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/p95Latency'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT number AS "Mean confidence"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/meanConfidence'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT number AS "Commands"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/commandCount'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT number AS "Rejection (session)"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/rejectionRate'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT number AS "Mean latency"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/meanLatency'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT number AS "Time-to-safe-stop"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/timeToSafeStop'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT number AS "Operator interventions"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/operatorInterventions'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT number AS "Calibration error (ECE)"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/calibrationError'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT t.v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(compound->'values') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(v, i) WHERE compound->'keys'->>(t.i::int - 1) = 'engagement'), (SELECT kv->>'value' FROM jsonb_array_elements(compound->'values') kv WHERE kv->>'key' = 'engagement')) AS "e"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIModuleStatus:intent' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT t.v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(compound->'values') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(v, i) WHERE compound->'keys'->>(t.i::int - 1) = 'recognition_mode'), (SELECT kv->>'value' FROM jsonb_array_elements(compound->'values') kv WHERE kv->>'key' = 'recognition_mode')) AS "m"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIModuleStatus:intent' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT t.v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(compound->'values') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(v, i) WHERE compound->'keys'->>(t.i::int - 1) = 'acoustic_condition'), (SELECT kv->>'value' FROM jsonb_array_elements(compound->'values') kv WHERE kv->>'key' = 'acoustic_condition')) AS "c"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIModuleStatus:intent' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT t.v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(compound->'values') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(v, i) WHERE compound->'keys'->>(t.i::int - 1) = 'accept_threshold'), (SELECT kv->>'value' FROM jsonb_array_elements(compound->'values') kv WHERE kv->>'key' = 'accept_threshold'))::float AS "t"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIModuleStatus:intent' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT t.v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(compound->'values') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(v, i) WHERE compound->'keys'->>(t.i::int - 1) = 'operator_id'), (SELECT kv->>'value' FROM jsonb_array_elements(compound->'values') kv WHERE kv->>'key' = 'operator_id')) AS "o"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIModuleStatus:intent' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (compound->>'data') AS "t"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIEvent:stt' AND id LIKE '%/transcript'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", COALESCE((SELECT t.v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(compound->'values') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(v, i) WHERE compound->'keys'->>(t.i::int - 1) = 'engagement'), (SELECT kv->>'value' FROM jsonb_array_elements(compound->'values') kv WHERE kv->>'key' = 'engagement')) AS "Engagement"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIModuleStatus:intent' AND id LIKE '%/status' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", COALESCE((SELECT t.v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(compound->'values') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(v, i) WHERE compound->'keys'->>(t.i::int - 1) = 'recognition_mode'), (SELECT kv->>'value' FROM jsonb_array_elements(compound->'values') kv WHERE kv->>'key' = 'recognition_mode')) AS "Recognition"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIModuleStatus:intent' AND id LIKE '%/status' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", COALESCE((SELECT t.v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(compound->'values') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(v, i) WHERE compound->'keys'->>(t.i::int - 1) = 'acoustic_condition'), (SELECT kv->>'value' FROM jsonb_array_elements(compound->'values') kv WHERE kv->>'key' = 'acoustic_condition')) AS "Condition"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIModuleStatus:intent' AND id LIKE '%/status' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (entityid) split_part(entityid, ':', 4) AS "Module",
  CASE (compound->>'level')::int WHEN 0 THEN 'OK' WHEN 1 THEN 'WARN' WHEN 2 THEN 'ERROR' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Health",
  COALESCE((SELECT t.v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(compound->'values') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(v, i) WHERE compound->'keys'->>(t.i::int - 1) = 'rate'), (SELECT kv->>'value' FROM jsonb_array_elements(compound->'values') kv WHERE kv->>'key' = 'rate'))::float AS "Rate", COALESCE((SELECT t.v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(compound->'values') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(v, i) WHERE compound->'keys'->>(t.i::int - 1) = 'rate_unit'), (SELECT kv->>'value' FROM jsonb_array_elements(compound->'values') kv WHERE kv->>'key' = 'rate_unit')) AS "Unit", COALESCE((SELECT t.v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(compound->'values') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(v, i) WHERE compound->'keys'->>(t.i::int - 1) = 'latency_ms'), (SELECT kv->>'value' FROM jsonb_array_elements(compound->'values') kv WHERE kv->>'key' = 'latency_ms'))::float AS "Latency"
FROM attributes WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIModuleStatus:%' AND id LIKE '%/status'
ORDER BY entityid, ts DESC

panels.title: Intent events
panels.description: Every decision of the confidence-aware interaction policy (aura_interfaces/IntentEvent). Kept by TROE as event history.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "Time", compound->>'intent' AS "Intent", compound->>'utterance' AS "Utterance",
  CASE (compound->>'decision')::int WHEN 0 THEN 'ACCEPT' WHEN 1 THEN 'CONFIRM' WHEN 2 THEN 'REJECT' WHEN 3 THEN 'IGNORE' END AS "Decision", compound->>'outcome' AS "Outcome",
  (compound->>'confidence')::float AS "Confidence", (compound->>'latency_ms')::float AS "Latency",
  compound->>'modality' AS "Modality", compound->>'acoustic_condition' AS "Condition",
  compound->>'operator_id' AS "Operator"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIEvent:intent' AND id LIKE '%/intentEvent' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (compound->>'decision')::int = 0) AS "ACCEPT",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE (compound->>'decision')::int = 1) AS "CONFIRM",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE (compound->>'decision')::int = 2) AS "REJECT",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE (compound->>'decision')::int = 3) AS "IGNORE"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIEvent:intent' AND id LIKE '%/intentEvent' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE compound->>'modality'='voice') AS "voice",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE compound->>'modality'='gesture') AS "gesture",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE compound->>'modality'='fused') AS "fused"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIEvent:intent' AND id LIKE '%/intentEvent' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Noise vs acoustic confidence
panels.description: Each dot is one intent event. Confidence drops as LAeq rises above ~75 dB.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", (compound->>'la_eq')::float AS "Noise LAeq"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:AirQualityObserved:$robot' AND id LIKE '%/reading' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", (compound->>'confidence')::float AS "Confidence"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIEvent:intent' AND id LIKE '%/intentEvent' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT (compound->>'confidence')::float AS "Confidence", (compound->>'latency_ms')::float AS "Latency (ms)"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid = 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRIEvent:intent' AND id LIKE '%/intentEvent' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", number AS "Success"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/commandSuccessRate' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", number AS "Rejection (5 min)"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/windowRejectionRate' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", number AS "False activation"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/falseActivationRate' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", number AS "Mean"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/meanLatency' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(observedat, ts) AS "time", number AS "p95"
FROM attributes
WHERE entityid LIKE 'urn:ngsi-ld:HRISession:%' AND id LIKE '%/p95Latency' AND coalesce(observedat, ts) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1
